summary: StepStone Private Credit Fund LLC filed a routine Form 8-K reporting a monthly closing under its continuous private offering. As of September 1, 2026, it sold 5,035,671 unregistered Shares for aggregate consideration of $132.0 million under subscription agreements, exempt via Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/S. NAV per Share was $26.21 at August 31, 2026; aggregate NAV about $3,074.1 million, portfolio fair value $4,443.4 million, and $1,600.9 million principal debt. The offering is continuous, up to $10 billion, with 117,312,958 Shares totaling $3,062.1 million issued to date.
